title: Naraka
body:
# Naraka : Rise of Herobrine Welcome to Naraka! This mod adds the Herobrine boss, new ores, and powerful materials crafted from vanilla ores. Defeat the boss to earn rewards, and use the new materials to craft powerful weapon! ## Features - Herobrine: A terrifying boss waiting in the Herobrine Sanctuary. - Diamond Golem: A powerful entity protecting the Diamond Pillar. - Nectarium: A unique, edible ore that is surprisingly delicious! > ### ![Sanctuary Compass](https://github.com/lalaalal/Naraka/blob/26.2/common/src/main/resources/assets/naraka/textures/item/sanctuary_compass_00.png?raw=true) Way to Herobrine > Search for a **Sanctuary Compass** from Wandering Traders or inside Cartographer chests in villages.
Images
